title: 19-BCV-022 - Unvented roof assembly

facts.text: The variance addresses unvented roof assemblies in Part 9 residential buildings.
It recognizes design requirements in evaluation report M-25608.000, “ACC – Alberta Unvented Roofs,” prepared by Jonathan Smegal of RDH Building Science Laboratories.
The code discussion explains that venting is generally required to limit moisture deterioration but recognizes specialized assemblies where ventilation may be unnecessary.
facts.locator: Same PDF, pp. 1–2, Discussion and Code References
